posts.name: A Someday Hero
posts.cooked:
We've reached an interesting point in Sentinels of the Multiverse where nearly every hero in the game has a nemesis they can be paired with. After Villains of the Multiverse (which will give us vengance style nemesis for almost everyone) you have to imagine they're going to go for another small set expansion. Another comfy "Two Heroes/Four Villains/Two Enviornments" deal. But where will they look? Which heroes are left?

Well I'm guessing there will be some Mini Expansion hero(s) alongside the VotM expansion so that will give them something. And they'll have to Heroes in that expansion to pair up. Who else?

The Scholor is (to my knowledge) the last Hero to lack a nemesis deck of anykind. He has a "Nemesis", but it's a minor one in Proletariat's deck. He's probably high on the list.

Bunker and Absolute Zero probably need one too. They have nemeses, but only in the Vengence style. Will Freight Train and Proletariat get individual decks? Or Will we see new Nemesis for our heroes to battle? Time will tell but I'm leaning on them to get new hero decks, maybe in mini Expansions!

Finally Unity is probably due for one. She has a Nemesis in Iron Legacy, but that's sort of alternate Timeline biz and he's also Nemesis to 5 other heroes, I think Unity deserves her own Villain.

Those are my thoughts so far. Is there any Hero I forgot about who is lonely with no name to curse at the heavans? Let me know in the comments. Also, who do you think deserves a Nemesis next? My Vote is on Unity and The Scholar for sure with Bunker and AZ as runner up's or Mini Expansion candidates.

A Someday Hero:

The Scholor is (to my knowledge) the last Hero to lack a nemesis deck of anykind. He has a "Nemesis", but it's a minor one in Proletariat's deck.

According to the challenges, his nemesis is someone called Biomancer.  Based on the little icon beside the challenge that mentions Biomancer, this person is shown on Tachyon's Sucker Punch card.  Maybe this villain will be a promo deck coming with Villains of the Multiverse?  https://greaterthangames.com/content/challenges-achievements-and-steam

A Someday Hero:

Bunker and Absolute Zero probably need one too. They have nemeses, but only in the Vengence style. Will Freight Train and Proletariat get individual decks? Or Will we see new Nemesis for our heroes to battle? Time will tell but I'm leaning on them to get new hero decks, maybe in mini Expansions!Finally Unity is probably due for one. She has a Nemesis in Iron Legacy, but that's sort of alternate Timeline biz and he's also Nemesis to 5 other heroes, I think Unity deserves her own Villain.

I feel like Unity deserves her own villain too, but maybe it makes sense for her not to have one, since she's supposedly an intern rather than a hero.  This actually puts an interesting spin on her frustration about this as expressed through the quotes she gives Swift Bot.  For instance, in Sentinel Tactics, Swift Bot says, " I am very fast and good at science, but I do not think interns should be heroes, because I am a jerk. "  But note how "just an intern" Unity doesn't a nemesis just to herself!  Maybe her status is actually protecting her and that's the real motivation behind it.

FYI, it's just an unofficial thing, but BGG user Yoshi has posted stand-alone conversions of the Vengeance villains.  One can use these to play them in the normal villain way, if one wants:  Yoshi's Scum and Villainy (and other stuff) | Sentinels of the Multiverse
